sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
சூது என்னவென்று அறியா பேதையிடம்
தூது அனுப்பி ஒரு பயனுமில்லை ஐயா
sections.translit:
sUdhu ennavendRu aRiyA pEdhaiyidam
thUdhu anuppi oru payanumillai aiyA
sections.en: Respected Sire, there is nothing to be gained by sending your emissaries to this innocent damsel who does not even know what deceit is.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
வாது புரிய வந்தீரோ என் வாயால்
ஏது திரும்ப வழியென்று சொல்ல வைப்பீரோ
sections.translit:
vAdhu puriya vandhIrO en vAyAl
Edhu thirumba vazhiyendRu solla vaippIrO
sections.en: Did you come here to justify your actions and argue with me? Are you going to force me to say which way you should be heading now?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
போது புலரு முன்னே கிளம்பிவிட்டால் ஊர்
மாது உடன் உறவாடியது தெரியாதென நினைத்தாலும்
காது வரை வந்த விஷயங்கள் வாய் ஜாலத்தால்
கோது என சாதித்தாலும் ஓலமிடுமுன் ஓடிவிடுமய்யா
sections.translit:
pOdhu pularu munnE kiLambivittAl Ur
mAdhu udan uRavAdiyadhu theriyAdhena ninaitthAlum
kAdhu varai vandha vishayangaL vAy jAlatthAl
kOdhu ena sAdhitthAlum Olamidumun OdividumayyA
sections.en: You may have thought that you won’t be caught if you left the house of that common woman before dawn, and that no one will find out about your escapades with her. I have already been briefed about what transpired there. You may still think that you can use your oratorical skills to establish that all those stories are hearsay and lies. Just run away and get lost before I shout.

notes: This imaginary song is based on the general Sangam literature - based on arguments between a thalaivan and thalaivi. The hero returns home before dawn after spending a night at the other woman’s home, so that his neighbors will not notice him. But the heroine has already been warned of his ways from her friends. She does not want to hear any defensive arguments from him and asks him to get lost. By now she is familiar with his expressive style and skills of persuasion.
